Critical banners blink every 380 ms; not ported (WCAG 2.2.2: blinking past 5 s needs a way to stop it), the caution's dashed border carries the tier without colour. The CCR overlay's amber SCR LOW (8893) is text drawn over the banner's pill, which keeps the banner's own warnCritical; with no banner warning, SCR LOW alone shows in the caution colour.

change: src/app/hud-warning.ts (new) holds the warning selection moved out of src/app/wreck-app.ts: activeWarnings lists every warning in order, selectWarning takes the first, isWarningBeepActive is legacy's hasWarning (every warning but the low NDL). Ceiling, low NDL and narcosis are added; open-circuit low gas becomes legacy's two tiers, low gas under 30 bar and the gas reserve under 50, both strict. src/presentation/presentation-state.ts adds decoStopDepthM (decoStop() of the model's lastCeilingM), nearNdlMin (the same-tick NDL, searched only up to 5 min, null in deco) and narcosisIndex; src/core/decompression.ts ndlMinutes takes an optional search bound, defaulting to legacy's 200 min. Eight English-only diveComputer.* strings; claims register anchors in DECOMPRESSION-001, NARCOSIS-001 and GAS-001. The model and the narcosis effects are unchanged. selectWarningTier gives legacy's warnCritical for the warning shown; src/app/wreck-app.ts writes it as data-tier on the alert and the chip, and src/app/diagnostic.css draws a caution in the HUD's caution tone #ffcc88 on legacy's dark amber pill with a dashed border. While SCR LOW is shown, the tier is the banner's under it: critical if the ceiling, the loop's PO2 over 1.6, narcosis over 0.70, a fast ascent or a low NDL holds, else caution.

counterChecks.method: Each mutation applied with sed to a file copied to a backup beforehand; tests/unit/hud-warning.test.ts run, and for the e2e cases the client rebuilt and the named specs run under the port lock with --retries=0. The first thirteen ran on the code of c6e4e6f (19 unit tests then, 6 e2e), the next four on cf90123 (21 unit tests, 8 e2e in tests/hud-warnings.spec.js plus tests/wreck-slice.spec.js:248), the next five on 9a8cb32 (24 unit tests, 8 e2e), the last two on a21797a (25 unit tests). Each file was then restored from its backup and compared with cmp: byte for byte identical in every case.
